flags.title: Live month AR is a partial snapshot
flags.detail: 2026-09 AR reads $2.65M against $1.48M for closed 2026-08 (+79%). Rent bills on the 1st and collects through the month, so the live figure runs hot. Headline numbers use 2026-08.

flags.title: AR is 31% versus a year ago
3 communities have 100% of AR in the 90+ bucket
flags.detail: Nothing current or mid-aged at all, which usually means a stale or migrated ledger rather than live delinquency: Cedar Grove Manufactured Housing Community, Lambeth Manufactured Housing Community, Valley View MHC. Worth a Rent Manager check before these drive collections decisions.

flags.title: 5 communities report 0% occupancy on 457 lots
flags.detail: Either genuinely empty or the ledger is not tracking occupancy. These lots stay in the portfolio denominator, so they pull reported occupancy down: Geiger RV (41 lots), Highlands (61 lots), Lucky Clover RV (59 lots), Paradise Lakes RV (175 lots), Trailerama MHP (121 lots). Confirm in Rent Manager, then either fix the ledger or add the record to registry.json.

flags.title: 9 communities post revenue with no budget loaded
flags.detail: Budget variance is blank for: Geiger Key RV Resort, Hendersons MHC, Hunter Springs MHP, McGregor Downs, Northgate RV, Parkwood Mobile Home Park, Regency I & II, Shirleys Trailer Park I, Shirleys Trailer Park II.

flags.title: 4 property records dropped as stale
flags.detail: No recent snapshot, treated as disposed or renamed: Lake Toho, Medallion, Mobile Manor, Vandemere Manufactured Housing Community. If any of these is still live, it needs a look in Rent Manager.
